question: On Windows systems prior to Vista, an attacker modifies a registry key so Winlogon loads a DLL at startup, enabling malicious code execution during logon. Which MITRE ATT&CK technique corresponds to this behavior, and why does it map to this attack pattern?
answer:
- T1547.004.
- T1547.004 corresponds to Winlogon-startup DLL loading, mapping CAPEC-579: changing registry so Winlogon loads a malicious helper DLL.
